name: Water Bucket
descriptionLines: &7A bucket filled with water.
&7Useful for putting out fires or landing safely from heights.

name: Flint and Steel
descriptionLines: &7Creates fire when used on blocks.
&7Can be used to ignite enemies or create light sources quickly.

name: Flashlight
descriptionLines: &7Portable light source for dark environments.
&7Essential for exploring caves and night operations.

name: Hard Cover
descriptionLines: &7Reinforced plating for creating instant cover.
&7Can be placed quickly to block enemy fire and create defensive positions.

name: Kevlar Insert
descriptionLines: &7Ballistic protection insert for body armor.
&7Provides additional protection against small arms fire and shrapnel.

name: Slime Pads
descriptionLines: &7Bouncy pads that absorb fall damage.
&7Place them below to safely descend from great heights or create bounce traps.

name: Trench Mask
descriptionLines: &7Protective mask for hazardous environments.
&7Filters out toxic gases and provides limited chemical protection.

name: Golden Apple
descriptionLines: &7Magical fruit that provides instant regeneration.
&7Can save your life in critical situations by rapidly healing wounds.

name: Chorus Fruit
descriptionLines: &7End dimension fruit that teleports the user randomly.
&7Useful for escaping dangerous situations or confusing enemies.

name: Power Hammer
descriptionLines: &7Advanced powered melee tool with enhanced striking force.
&7Can break through reinforced materials and deliver powerful shockwaves.

name: XSAPI Insert
descriptionLines: &7Extra Small Arms Protective Insert for maximum ballistic protection.
&7Offers superior defense against high-caliber rounds and armor-piercing ammunition.

name: Ender Pearl
descriptionLines: &7Mystical pearl that teleports the user to where it lands.
&7Perfect for quick repositioning or accessing hard-to-reach areas.

name: Mining Charge
descriptionLines: &7Controlled explosive for rapid excavation and breaching.
&7Can clear large areas quickly or create instant entry points.

name: Claymore
descriptionLines: &7Directional anti-personnel mine for area denial.
&7Fires shrapnel in a forward arc when triggered by enemy movement.

name: Night Vision Goggles
descriptionLines: &7Electro-optical device that amplifies available light.
&7Provides clear vision in complete darkness and low-light conditions.

name: Velvet Band-Aid
descriptionLines: &7Advanced medical patch with rapid healing properties.
&7Applies instant regeneration and stops bleeding immediately upon application.

name: 8 Inch Blade Autoinjector
descriptionLines: &7Combination medical injector and combat blade.
&7Delivers stimulants while functioning as an emergency melee weapon.

name: Elytra
descriptionLines: &7Wing-like membranes that enable gliding through the air.
&7Allows for rapid aerial mobility and strategic positioning from heights.

name: Jumppack
descriptionLines: &7Personal propulsion system for enhanced mobility.
&7Enables rocket-assisted jumps for tactical advantage.

name: Bottle of Scrumpy
descriptionLines: &7Mysterious alcoholic beverage with unusual properties.
&7Grants an extra life but may have unpredictable side effects.
